title: buglossoides incrassata subsp. splitgerberi
intro: Buglossoides incrassata subsp. splitgerberi, commonly known as Splitgerber's bugloss, is a plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in the reduction of pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Splitgerber's bugloss are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as an anti-spasmodic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
